repairs_expected.reason: The Edge Cases section's only line ('The system handles errors gracefully') is a placeholder-quality statement with no actual documented behavior to truthfully derive a Trace-level question from.
repairs_expected.proposed_repair: Replace the vague Edge Cases bullet with a specific documented failure condition — e.g. restating the permanently-failed-after-3-attempts behavior already established in User Story 2's Acceptance Scenario 2.

questions_common.text: What is the primary purpose of this feature?
options: Retry only failed rows automatically instead of requiring a full re-upload
Allow users to edit rows before import
Send a notification when import completes
questions_common.expected_answer: To automatically retry just the specific rows that failed on a prior attempt, instead of requiring the user to re-upload the whole file.
questions_common.source_heading: User Story 2 - Automatically retry rows that fail on first attempt (Priority: P1)

questions_common.text: Explain how User Story 2 changes the import experience compared to User Story 1 when some rows fail.
options: The whole file is re-uploaded by the user
Only the failed rows are automatically retried, up to 3 attempts each, before being reported as permanently failed
Failed rows are skipped and never retried
The import is cancelled entirely if any row fails
questions_common.expected_answer: Only the rows that failed are automatically retried (up to 3 total attempts each); rows still failing after 3 attempts are reported as permanently failed, without affecting the rows that did succeed.

questions_common.text: A user uploads a file where 3 of 20 rows fail on the first attempt due to a transient conflict, but would succeed if retried. What does the user need to do, and what will the final report show?
questions_common.expected_answer: Nothing — the user doesn't need to re-upload anything. The system automatically retries just those 3 rows, and the final report shows all 20 rows succeeded (3 of them after retry), assuming the retries succeed within 3 attempts.
questions_common.source_heading: FR-001; FR-002; FR-004; User Story 2 Acceptance Scenario 1

questions_common.text: This spec requires the system to both retry failed rows automatically (FR-002) and cap retries at 3 attempts per row (FR-003). If a row failed on attempts 1 and 2 but succeeded on attempt 3, would it be reported as succeeded or as failed?
questions_common.expected_answer: Succeeded — FR-004 requires reporting rows that succeeded only after a retry as succeeded, distinct from rows that are permanently failed after exhausting all 3 attempts (FR-003). Succeeding on the 3rd attempt is still success, not permanent failure.

trace_question_if_approved.text: What happens to a specific row if it fails all 3 retry attempts?
trace_question_if_approved.expected_answer: The system stops retrying that row, reports it as permanently failed, and still reports the rows that did succeed rather than treating the whole import as failed.

trace_question_if_declined.text: What happens to a specific row if it fails all 3 retry attempts?
trace_question_if_declined.expected_answer: The system stops retrying that row, reports it as permanently failed, and still reports the rows that did succeed rather than treating the whole import as failed.
trace_question_if_declined.source_heading: User Story 2 Acceptance Scenario 2 (used as the already-established alternative, since the Edge Cases repair was declined)
